items.title: D'Andre Swift: DNP on Wednesday
items.text:
Swift didn't practice Thursday due to hip and knee injuries.

items.title: Mike Evans: To be limited Wednesday
items.text:
Coach Kyle Shanahan said Evans (ribs) is expected to be limited at Wednesday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Dealing with soreness
items.text:
Nabers said he took on "as much as I could" at Wednesday's practice, after which he noted he's dealing with undisclosed soreness, Connor Hughes of SNY.tv reports.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Limited in first Week 5 practice
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Flowers (hamstring) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
